inputs.notes: loader optional-missing carry defaults recorded in script; FIRST resets UST/MOL/QSFC; atmosphere held for ten successive surface-memory calls, not forecast steps

preamble.only_adaptation: 2Dsurface/3Datmosphere indexing to the standalone1D driver; same literal statements
preamble.body:
IF (itimestep==1) THEN
           DO i=1,ncol
              UST(i)=MAX(0.04*SQRT(U1D(i)*U1D(i) + V1D(i)*V1D(i)),0.001)
              MOL(i)=0.     ! Tstar
              QSFC(i)=QV1D(i)/(1.+QV1D(i))
              qstar(i)=0.0
           ENDDO
        ENDIF
